dependencies.coverage_note: Current staged riskAnalyst review of six identified upstream paths; incomplete inventory and no downstream survey. Distinct scopes are non-additive. Source observations remain dated; no independent RPC replay claimed.
dependencies.score_rationale: Retain 6.0 after current review: dependence on the Aave lending/liquidation/oracle stack and common ecosystem remains concentrated; the largest facilitator is44.35% of699m origin issuance, not a collateral allocation. Wrapper and stablecoin issuer routes plus CCIP/remote reserves add distinct failure paths. Established Aave infrastructure supports a middle-range assessment, while incomplete per-reserve and downstream mapping limits confidence. Legacy seized GSM conditions are not additionally charged here; current module existence and executable exit belong on Stability/Exit. No incident-caused loss or new score-changing counterparty exposure is established by this packet.

issuer.summary: GHO is governed by Aave DAO, with a documented public proposal and voting process and delegated operational stewards. This review retains Issuer6.5 on the established governance organization, public decision record and disclosed operating framework. It does not establish a legal guarantor, independently audited issuer finances or a universal holder right to redeem at par. Contract security and control thresholds are assessed separately; the unresolved authority walk receives no issuer credit.
issuer.summary_source: riskAnalyst authored review2026-10-30 of official GHO/governance documentation and the hash-verified BM evidence package. Retention is a current editorial decision, not automatic adoption of the September23 rationale.

historical_assessment.summary: Aave DAO remains credible and mature, and seizing an impaired module is defensible risk management executed through governance. Not raised either: the response happened, but this report only learned of it by re-reading the chain two months later.
historical_assessment.source: riskAnalyst/assets/gho.md; verbatim historical rationale, not a current assessment

facts: Issuer identity: Aave DAO. Official GHO documentation: https://aave.com/docs/ecosystem/gho
Aave documents delegated steward limits and update cooldowns. Documented policy is not a measurement of every live authority path: https://www.aave.com/docs/ecosystem/governance
Historical issuer score 6.5/10 is retained as provenance only; it is not promoted to a current score.
issuer.score_rationale: Retain6.5: established public governance and disclosed decision processes remain positive entity evidence; no new independently established issuer misconduct or guaranteed-recovery obligation. Legal recourse, comprehensive issuer financial evidence and current operational outcome verification remain limits. Audit counts, bounty amounts, signer thresholds and technical delay claims receive no Axis6 credit. Legacy seized-module handling is historical context, not the sole rationale for this current score.
